title: Cottage by Riverside Village.
description:
Modern, light and airy cottage in trendy East Nashville.  Walking distance to Riverside Village with it's eclectic restaurants and bars.  Or a shot uber ride to 5-points or Broadway downtown Nashville.  3 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms makes this the perfect house for 3 couples wanting their own space.

The space
This is an entire stand alone house.  Not apartment or condo.

Guest access
Guests are welcome to use the entire house I do keep my personal clothing and items in the master bedroom closet.  Please use other cabinets and storage for your items.

Other things to note
If you want to bring additional guests after you have made your booking,  But please let me know prior to the beginning of your stay so I can make sure it does not exceed the maximum occupancy allowed by the city and let you know if there are additional charges.

Nashville city codes enforces strict occupancy limits per house so please understand that undisclosed additional guests may result in the cancelation of the  reservation and forfeiture of the deposit.

NO PARTIES OR LOUD OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES PERMITTED.  Sitting on the patio and hanging big a meal or quiet conversation is fine.  (Nashville city enforces strict penalties on hosts for complaints filed by neighbors.)
